paper_title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
core_problem: Existing language model inference methods sample continuous language sequences locally without incorporating planning, lookahead, or backtracking to evaluate intermediate reasoning choices.
methodology_summary: Introduces the Tree of Thoughts (ToT) framework, which enables LMs to evaluate intermediate intermediate thoughts towards solving problems and navigate search spaces using systematic search algorithms such as breadth-first search and depth-first search.
empirical_results: ToT significantly improves problem-solving capabilities over standard Chain of Thought baselines, boosting success rates on challenging tasks from 4% to 74%.
explicit_limitations: Deliberate search methods like ToT require substantially more computational resources and API costs than standard sampling methods, and may not be necessary for simpler tasks that LMs already solve easily.
